brand.name: Stepler
brand.tagline: Collect photos, videos and stories from your event in one place

landing.metaTitle: Stepler — photos and videos from every guest in one collection
landing.metaDescription: Create a collection for your event and share a link or QR code. Guests add photos and videos from their phones — no app, no sign-up.
landing.lede: Show guests a QR code or send them a link. They add photos and videos straight from their phone’s gallery — no app, no sign-up.

photos.p01: Bride and groom laughing under a stone archway
photos.p10: A guest photographs the couple on her phone

photos.p06: A birthday cake with lit candles
photos.p02: The bride dancing with guests under string lights

noApp.title: No app, no sign-up
noApp.text: Guests open the link in the browser of any phone.

onePlace.title: One place instead of a dozen chats
onePlace.text: No more collecting shots from chats or asking people to send them again.

original.title: Original quality
original.text: Files are kept exactly as they were uploaded, without messenger compression.

control.title: You decide who sees what
control.text: Guests see each other’s frames, or only add their own.
